description: Block git commits if tests fail — run npm test before allowing commit. Audit 2026-06-24 — fixed broken `echo '$TOOL_INPUT'` pattern (single quotes prevent expansion; $TOOL_INPUT is not a shell env var — Claude Code passes hook input on stdin as JSON).

hooks.command: INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -qE '^git[[:space:]]+commit'; then printf 'Running tests before commit...\n'; if ! npm test --silent 2>&1; then printf 'BLOCKED: Tests failed. Fix tests before committing.\n' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json. Claude Code passes the hook payload on stdin as JSON — the command reads it via jq. Exit code 2 blocks the git commit and shows the stderr message to Claude. Customize 'npm test' to your test command (e.g. 'composer test', 'pytest', 'cargo test'). Requires jq.
